answerKey.location: canonical.json (internal, excluded from the candidate package by allowlist construction)

clarificationFacts: Dana Whitfield (Operations Manager) wants a reliable daily operational view of shipment delays
Priya Anand (VP of Operations) wants a defensible explanation the board can trust
Dana and Priya have not aligned on deliverable shape — the candidate must clarify before overbuilding
Carrier on-time rates in carriers.csv are self-reported claims, not verified actuals

correctness.description: The reconciled join matches every delay row to its shipment (or flags it unmatched) instead of silently dropping mismatched ID formats; tests and evals pass.
observableAnchors: pytest suite (tests/test_reconcile.py): 6/6 pass with a correct implementation
No silent row loss: matched + unmatched rows account for every input delay row
ID normalization handles missing SHP- prefix and missing leading zeros

engineeringJudgment.description: Chooses the smallest fix that restores data integrity; does not rewrite unrelated code; keeps the fix reviewable.
observableAnchors: Fix is localized to the join/normalization path, not a rewrite of the pipeline
Unmatched rows are surfaced, not discarded
Does not modify the test suite to fake a green run

responseToRequirements.description: Adapts when the requirement update arrives: acknowledges the earlier board deadline and re-plans the deliverable.
observableAnchors: curveball_acknowledged event after the update is presented
Deliverable/handoff reflects the earlier deadline and the stakeholder conflict
Does not ignore the update and submit against the original brief

workCommunication.description: Handoff explains what changed, how it was tested, what risks remain, and next steps — in the candidate's own words.
observableAnchors: All four handoff fields complete (whatChanged, testing, remainingRisks, nextSteps)
Names the carrier self-report caveat explicitly
Follow-up answers are substantive, not one-word

expectedOutcomes.greenState: A correct normalization + reconciled join passes 6/6 pytest tests and evals report zero failures.
expectedOutcomes.partialState: A candidate who submits before the requirement update is marked an intentional partial; adaptation is recorded as unobserved and reports must not claim it was measured.

forbiddenShortcuts: Hardcoding expected outputs instead of computing the join
Deleting delay rows to make counts match

humanReview.note: No human reviewer has signed off on this scenario release. Required before any production use.

intendedFailures.note: The red state is the expected starting state for candidates, not a defect.
intendedFailures.redState: As shipped (src/reconcile.py is a NotImplementedError stub): 3 fix-dependent tests fail cleanly with NotImplementedError; the defect-demonstrating test passes; evals exit non-zero with candidate guidance and no traceback.

intendedRegression.demonstratedBy: test_naive_join_drops_mismatched_ids passes on the pristine stub, proving the defect exists before the candidate fixes anything
intendedRegression.summary: Planted data-integrity defect: the naive exact-match join in the shipped code silently drops delay rows whose shipment IDs use a different format (missing SHP- prefix / missing leading zeros) than shipments.csv.

knownIssues: None verified beyond the intended red state below. Report new issues here with a reproduction.
